get_config: get the default GenMD4-S training config for OpenWebText dataset
sweep: run a hyperparameter sweep with varying learning rate, dropout rate, and weight decay
build_config_genmd4: build a GenMD4-S model training config for OpenWebText with 1024 sequence length
test_get_config: test the get_config function returns a valid ConfigDict with expected keys
review_sweep: review the sweep function that launches work units with varying hyperparameters
